resources.string: The default palette stays free. With Pro you can mix your own colors to tell topics, promises and prayers apart.
Your free studies are used up
You have used your free chapter studies. With Pro you can study any chapter with AI, as many times as you want — along with unlimited day studies and chat.
Each day you can unlock one chapter to listen to with a short video. With Pro you can listen to any chapter, as many as you want — and keep going into the next one on its own.
